Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for booking time for the Redwood Inference demo on Sep 23rd at 10:00am PT. Attaching the brief demo deck and a short SOW for context (attachments: redwood_demo-deck.pdf, acme_pre-demo_sow.pdf).

One quick note — we've seen some customers' SSO/firewall policies block meet.google.com links when an invite is sent from an external calendar. If your team or contractors have any guest restrictions, the Google Meet link I'm about to include might not work for everyone:

  - Proposed Meet link: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij

If your IT blocks meet.google.com in calendar invite metadata, can you confirm whether Zoom would be acceptable? If so we can resend the invite from our Zoom account and include a registrant flow if your SSO needs it.
